title: A Systematic Review of Open Datasets Used in Text-to-Image (T2I) Gen AI Model Safety
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion. It analyzed datasets for Text-to-Image model safety based on broad harm categories like sexual content, violence, and discrimination, without a specific breakdown for religious contexts.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study.
